// diagnostic

E0073

This collecting loop path produces no item.

What

This collecting loop path produces no item.

Why

Every accepted iteration must contribute one non-unit value unless `next` explicitly omits it.

Fix

return a value on this path, or use `next` to omit the item. Remove `->` if the loop only performs effects.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0073: tests/ui/yielding_loop_missing_item.stderr.
